text:
alex: quick check — i'm seeing per-model runtime flags from the new CM not picked up by the canary deployment after merge of PR #789. TF plan showed no pod restart. any ideas?
jia: are we still using the checksum annotation pattern on the deployment? if deployment doesn't reference checksum it won't rollout.
alex: yes we used checksum/config: ${data.template_file.config_sha} in the deployment annotation. TF plan shows the annotation changed? it actually shows no changes.
sam: did we accidentally move some keys into a Secret in the new config? TF will treat secret resources differently and if deployment references the secret as envFrom it won't show as configmap checksum.
alex: good call — the PR split feature flags into a secret for safety (feature_flags.yaml -> secret). but the deployment only has checksum/config for the configmap.
jia: simplest fix: add checksum for the secret as another annotation and wire it into the deployment template. example: 
```
metadata:
  annotations:
    checksum/config: "${data.template_file.config_sha}"
    checksum/flags-secret: "${data.external_secret.flags_sha}"
```
then k8s will detect change and rollout.
alex: we generate flags_sha via `external` data source in TF, right? i remember we had a small shell step that calculates sha256 of the secret payload.
sam: yep. if you're using the `kubernetes_secret` resource sometimes TF doesn't update the sha because lifecycle create_before_destroy is set weirdly. quick debug: run `kubectl get deploy app-canary -o yaml | yq .metadata.annotations` and `kubectl describe rs` to see why pods didn't recreate.
alex: ran `kubectl get deploy app-canary -o yaml | yq .metadata.annotations` — only checksum/config present. secret annotation missing. PR didn't include the secret checksum in the template.
oj: ops-bot: (automated) noticed: terraform apply completed at 2026-03-17T12:03:00Z; no rolling update detected.
jia: if we want low-risk, add a small Kustomize patch in the canary overlay that injects secret checksum annotation. can do a 1-line strategic merge patch in overlays/canary/kustomization.yaml.
sam: also double-check the configmap mount vs envFrom usage — if flags are consumed via files (volumeMount) vs env, the rollout semantics differ depending on your reloader/controller. we use stakater/reloader in some clusters, but our default pattern is checksum annotations.
alex: plan: i'll open a tiny follow-up PR to 1) add checksum/flags-secret annotation, 2) add docs note in infra/README about secret-sha generation, and 3) add a short smoke test in CI that runs `kubectl rollout status` after deploy. tagging @jia for review.
jia: lgtm, please include the `data.external` snippet so sha is generated in plan phase, else we won't see drift in `terraform plan`. example: 
```
data "external" "flags_sha" {
  program = ["/bin/sh", "-c", "printf '%s' \"$(jq -c . < flags.json)\" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1"]
}
```
then reference `data.external.flags_sha.result.out` in the annotation.
alex: thanks — will do. i'll leave the PR draft with a note and ping here when ready.
deploy-bot: triggered: canary redeploy queued when annotation changed. :rocket:
